portraits.label: Тростниковый
portraits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new original portrait for the Duelyant gothic fantasy character selection series.
Input image roles: Image 1 is ONLY the established rendering style, framing and lighting reference, NOT facial identity or beauty proportions. Images 2–4 are supporting gothic texture and material references, never copy their costumes or anatomy.
A close head-and-shoulders portrait of one living adult androgynous HUMAN, no beard or makeup, human ears. Vertical 2:3, 1024x1536. Head fully inside with small margin, eyes around 40% down; three-quarter face turned toward IMAGE RIGHT with both eyes visible. Plain dark coarse cloth at bottom, same crop as Image 1.
Keep the series style: hand-painted etched texture, sculptural organic facial volume, restrained charcoal/ochre/ivory palette, directional upper front-left light and deep shadows, nearly black background with subtle dark teal. Clearly an old gothic fantasy illustration, not a photograph or glossy CGI.
NEW DIRECTION: believable everyday human faces, visibly irregular and lived-in, not handsome model faces. Respect the specified ethnic appearance without caricature. Varied face proportions including roundness, soft cheeks, broad noses, asymmetry and aging. Preserve all individual irregularities specified below; do not beautify, smooth skin or turn them into a generic angular fashion model. Dignified calm expression; no evil coding or grotesque exaggeration. Scars if specified are old and fully healed, no blood, open wounds or gore. Ethnic appearance is independent from character morality and imperfections.
No text, frame, watermark, jewelry, weapons, armor, hats, horns, magic, glow, landscape, collage, multiple people, anime, cosmetic retouch, glamour or uniform square heroic jaw.
NEW CHARACTER: East Asian appearance, adult age 32. Round wide face, warm light-medium skin, monolid dark brown eyes, low broad nasal bridge, soft full cheeks and a small slightly off-center chin. Straight black hair cropped unevenly above ears. Noticeable old acne pitting across both cheeks, uneven brows and mild under-eye puffiness. No battle scar. This must not resemble the reference person's facial structure.
